title: Reversal selector screen: does the 1-day cross-sectional return rank separate width-book (gbb) trades?
origin: research/xsec_screen (af0fcec1): 1-day momentum is reversal across the 10 wf pairs (pooled t -4.9, both halves) but a standalone daily book loses to costs. A selector re-orders trades NNNC already takes, so it adds no turnover.
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). A PASS here licenses only a separately pre-registered sizer backtest arm; nothing is adopted.

instrument.book: the ARO width book (034 S1 instrument, research/label_screen/separation.py): gbb rule + gates + bb_width >= previous fold's count-matched cut (width_twin.json), simulated once per fold from the wf_aro_g24 tables with the 24 h stop-loss grace
instrument.sanity: early trade count must equal 034's 412; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (instrument drift)
instrument.outcome: pp per trade (the simulator's pp column)

signal.at: the trade's signal bar s = entry bar - 1 (its close is known when the entry bar opens)
signal.r1d: log close[s] - log close[s-96] for every pair that has both bars at those timestamps
signal.rank_pct: (rank of the trade pair's r1d among them, ascending, ties averaged - 1) / (n - 1); 0 = fell most

rule.primary: PASS iff ALL: (1) gap = agree - disagree pp/trade > 0 in BOTH halves; (2) AUC of score vs pp > 0 above 0.5 in BOTH halves; (3) pooled one-sided permutation p <= 0.05 for the gap (agree labels shuffled within fold, 10000 permutations, seed 0)
rule.inconclusive: early trade count != 412, or > 5% of trades without a rank (fewer than 6 pairs), or any fold whose agree share is 0 or 1

descriptive: the gap within the control's own agree and disagree trades (does the rank add to ARO's decision?)
Spearman of rank_pct with the control's p_buy (orthogonality)
the control-at-share gap 0.100 (034, early) for scale only -- not a pass condition
3-day variant (r3d over 288 bars), same split -- not a pass condition
next_on_pass: pre-register a width-book sizer arm (stake up for agree trades) on the 15-fold backtest vs w_aro and cs_aro; seed-free (model-free signal)
not_done: no backtest P&L is read by this screen; no parameter is fitted
